regions.sentence: USA: splicing raw VIIRS onto MODIS shows 4.05x the hotspots per year in 2019-2025 compared with 2001-2017; MODIS itself shows 1.07x. The naive splice overstates post-2018 activity by a factor of 3.78; the harmonized series shows 1.08x.

Europe: splicing raw VIIRS onto MODIS shows 2.15x the hotspots per year in 2019-2025 compared with 2001-2017; MODIS itself shows 0.62x. The naive splice overstates post-2018 activity by a factor of 3.48; the harmonized series shows 0.63x.
